plugin_yml:
name: WorldGuard
main: com.sk89q.worldguard.bukkit.WorldGuardPlugin
version: "7.0.16+2355-f7fded2"
depend: [WorldEdit]
api-version: "1.21.11"
folia-supported: true

name: LunaAirDrop
version: '1.0.3-MidgardFix'
main: org.by1337.bairdrop.BAirDrop
api-version: '1.21.4'
authors: [ By1337 ]
depend: [WorldGuard, WorldEdit]
softdepend:
  - PlaceholderAPI
load: POSTWORLD
description: event airdrop
commands:
  bairdrop:
    description: Standart Command
    aliases: [bair]
    usage: Usage /bair help
permissions:
  bair.*:
    description: All cmd
    default: op
    children:
      bair.tp: true
      bair.reload: true
      bair.create: true
      bair.edit: true
      bair.menu: true
      bair.chance: true
      bair.start: true
      bair.stop: true
      bair.listeners: true
      bair.get: true
      bair.delete: true
      bair.clone: true
      bair.compass: true
      bair.js: true
  bair.js:
    description: /bair js
    default: op
  bair.tp:
    description: /bair tp <id>
    default: op
  bair.reload:
    description: /bair reload
    default: op
  bair.create:
    description: /bair create <id>
    default: op
  bair.edit:
    description: /bair edit <id>
    default: op
  bair.menu:
    description: /bair menu <id>
    default: op
  bair.chance:
    description: /bair chance <id>
    default: op
  bair.start:
    description: /bair start <id>
    default: op
  bair.stop:
    description: /bair stop <id>
    default: op
  bair.listeners:
    description: /bair listeners <id>
    default: op
  bair.get:
    description: /bair get <item>
    default: op
  bair.delete:
    description: /bair delete <id>
    default: op
  bair.clone:
    description: /bair clone <id> <new id>
    default: op
  bair.compass:
    description: /bair compass <player> <amount>
    default: op
  bair.delay:
    description: /bair delay
    default: true
  bair.gps:
    description: /bair gps
    default: true
